description: This file defines a PHP class 'Component' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Vue'. It models a UI component with properties such as name and props, and provides methods to manipulate these properties.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Represents a Vue.js component with a name and properties, providing methods for property management.
